completion: HS-02 own design now specified. Actual private store/volume qualification shared with HS-01; no assertion store implemented or trusted now.

trustBoundary.location: server-derived DSH_HOME/software/vesta/operations, private path separate from public software/<id>.json
trustBoundary.subjects: authenticated host adapter only writes; workspaceFiles/picker/HTTP paths remain space-guarded; Vesta CLI/shell sandbox must not grant this metadata path
trustBoundary.basis: Existing platform space guards and sandbox health denyDSH probe demonstrate an available design route; not current Vesta deployment qualification. Same uid,0700 or hash alone are never sufficient.
trustBoundary.threat: Browser/Agent/project-controlled bytes cannot fabricate original outcome; privileged host administrator compromise outside this adapter guarantee. Missing/failed isolation -> expired-unresolved/new-lifecycle only, never upgrade JSON to authority.

record.actualFiles: owned space refs+roles+sha+length; no work bytes here
record.cleanup: owned candidate retain set and reachability/reader leases
record.expiresAt: null unless explicitly retired; no invented duration
record.requestBinding: server-issued captureGeneration/sequence + client requestId + commandDigest; not an arbitrary reusable request grant

storeOrder: create exclusive generation temp under anchored private directory
serialize closed record; file sync; exact readback
atomic rename to immutable next generation; parent sync including newly created directory edges
update in-memory registry only after durable record succeeds; failed write keeps prior generation and uncertain may-publish state
crashOutcomes: not permitted to publish; do not infer not-published from mere missing record after restart
intent exists, primary may have changed
commit-unknown, retain all possibly reachable artifacts
committed-unverified/unknown; only matching protected registry and actual semantic evidence may prove original outcome
complete record trusted, actual target differs
journal caller-writable/corrupt/missing or no original source
expired-unresolved; self-consistent actual files may open only explicit new lifecycle

query.request: operationId+targetDigest only; authenticated principal from request context; no client path or trusted flag
query.lookup: protected registry exact operation/profile/sequence; reject principal/target mismatch before work
query.read: reauthorize current actual space path, enumerate resource graph and compare full current materialized objects under03; stored passed/hash not enough
query.reply: closed status/proofScope/evidenceRef from HS/2 RecoveryReply; complete only exact captured snapshot. Query never writes primary, retries publication, rebinds current WorkRef, clears newer dirty, or closes draft
query.restart: registry generation belongs to historical op, current service/claim is fresh; old page token never revives. Fresh UI may read historical outcome but cannot install old epoch as current

retention.unresolved: no eviction while may publish/reachable or source needed; quota pressure rejects new operation and preserves draft
retention.terminal: no wall-clock TTL required. Retire only after durable terminal+consumer acknowledgement+no reader/reachable references; query retired ID returns expired-unresolved; no operation ID reuse
retention.sourceAndCandidates: all work bytes in authorized personal space under existing quota; settings contain refs only
retention.metadata: existing DSH technical quota; atomic metadata admission before operation. No invented256MiB/TTL/Vesta numeric defaults or separate quota service

cleanup: No cleanup from journal existence alone. Host terminal proof, owned exact candidate and no reachability/readers all required; uncertain retain sets survive until explicit verified resolution.
requestRetirement: After restart old capture generation cannot admit mutation. Retired/missing operation IDs only query expired-unresolved; replay never creates a new operation. Fresh publish requires explicit new capture with a host-issued generation/sequence. Keep unresolved records and compact retired contiguous sequence intervals in same private metadata budget; do not need one permanent work-copy/tombstone per terminal record.
